body:
VERDICT goal: the goal is one opener for every imas.DBEntry construction; nova/imas/dataset.py:540 is the only construction site left in nova/*.py and nova/imas/db_entry.py is deleted.
VERDICT done_when: done_when asks for a one-site search, a base-fail/head-pass test and a two-arm suite with no added failure; search and test material are recorded, and the arms show 0 added and 0 removed ids with 2 of 25 modules unmeasured.
VERDICT write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths; all 15 changed files sit inside them.
VERDICT manifest: read; it records the new test's mutation result and the two-arm gate JSON (exit 124, completed:false, 50 identical ids per arm).
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit against 7a31104db; 3d69662eb routes the opener and 11 call sites and deletes db_entry.py, 2a8ae1f8f adds only the evidence fragment, and each site keeps its dd_version.
CALL_SITES: nova/imas/dataset.py:Dataset.db_entry, nova/imas/dataset.py:Dataset.is_valid, nova/equilibrium/steering_frames.py:dereference_wall, nova/imas/diiid_description.py:active_coil_response_from_imas, nova/imas/diiid_machine_ids.py:_source_dd_version, nova/imas/diiid_machine_ids.py:_read_source_description, nova/imas/mast_solve_input_ids.py:open_verified_description, nova/imas/mast_solve_input_ids.py:write_and_reopen, nova/imas/mast_geometry.py:write_and_reopen, nova/imas/validator_case.py:netcdf_to_hdf5, nova/imas/validator_case.py:ValidatorLayer.entry, nova/io/egress.py:IdsEgress.write, nova/media/sources/diiid_efit.py:read_pulse, nova/scripts/diiid_machine_artifact.py:_declared_dd_version
SCORE goal_fidelity: 20
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: nova/imas/dataset.py:540 is the only imas.DBEntry construction left in nova/*.py and both Dataset.db_entry (dataset.py:765) and is_valid (dataset.py:770) call open_db_entry.
SCORE evidence: 14
JUSTIFICATION evidence: the manifest's baseline_suite and after_suite both record exit 124 and completed:false with 0 added and 0 removed ids, leaving 2 of 25 modules unmeasured.
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: every changed path is inside the manifest's declared write paths and the diff adds nothing the goal does not imply.
SCORE durability: 18
JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/test_imas_opener.py:30-84 reddens on a reverted opener, as its negative control shows, though line 99 compares against the value the test itself supplied.
SCORE fit: 19
JUSTIFICATION fit: open_db_entry (nova/imas/dataset.py:512) matches the file's numpydoc and modern type-hint style and adds no forbidden name.
SCORE reuse: 20
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the db_entry property in nova/imas/dataset.py already owned the opening policy, the change extends it, and a capability search over nova/ found no other DBEntry opener.
FINDING docs/evidence/fragments/nova-portfolio-replan/replan-dbentry-constructor.html:21 non-blocking: each arm exited 124 with 2 of 25 modules unmeasured and tests/test_imas_opener.py absent from both arms, so the zero-added-failure result covers 23 modules and the head-pass is inferred.
FINDING tests/test_imas_opener.py:99 non-blocking: the assertion compares against the Version the test supplied at line 93, so it catches non-forwarding but not a transform, and backend (line 94) is never asserted.

findings.text: the two-arm gate ran each arm to exit 124 (timeout) with tests/test_steering_frames.py and tests/test_playable_session.py truncated mid-run and tests/test_imas_opener.py absent from both module lists, so done_when (3)'s 'no added failure' is established for 23 of 25 modules only and done_when (2)'s head-pass of the new test is inferred from the mutation log rather than recorded as a head arm.

test_db_entry_property_passes_the_dataset_dd_version asserts record["args"][1] == Version("3.39.0"), the same value the test supplied through SimpleNamespace at line 93, so it detects non-forwarding but cannot detect a transform of dd_version, and the backend value supplied at line 94 is never asserted.

justifications.durability: tests/test_imas_opener.py:30-84 asserts read-only default, dd_version pass-through, no dd_version when absent, backend routing and is_valid routing, and the negative control shows test_opener_passes_dd_version_through reddens when the opener drops dd_version.
justifications.evidence: the manifest's baseline_suite and after_suite both record exit 124 and completed:false with 50 identical ids, so the zero-added-failure result is truncated to 23 of 25 modules.
justifications.fit: open_db_entry (dataset.py:512) sits beside the Datastore class, follows the file's numpydoc and modern type-hint style, and adds no name the naming rules forbid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/imas/dataset.py:540 is the only imas.DBEntry construction left in nova/*.py and both Dataset.db_entry (dataset.py:765) and is_valid (dataset.py:770) call open_db_entry.
justifications.reuse: nova/imas/dataset.py already owned the DD-version opening policy in the db_entry property; the change extends that owner and deletes the competing nova/imas/db_entry.py subclass, and a capability search over nova/ found no other DBEntry opener.
justifications.scope_discipline: every changed path (dataset.py, the 11 call-site modules, tests/test_imas_opener.py, docs/evidence/...html) is inside the manifest's declared write paths.

verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 7a31104db; 3d69662eb refactors the opener and 11 call sites plus deletes db_entry.py, 2a8ae1f8f adds only the evidence fragment, and every call site keeps the dd_version it had.
verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for a one-site search, a test that fails at base and passes at head, and a two-arm suite with no added failure; the search is recorded, tests/test_imas_opener.py and its mutation log exist, and the arms show 0 added / 0 removed failure ids with 2 of 25 modules unmeasured.
verdicts.goal: the goal is to route every imas.DBEntry construction through one opener in nova/imas/dataset.py; the landed open_db_entry at dataset.py:540 is the single .py construction site (search receipt: nova/imas/dataset.py:540 only) and nova/imas/db_entry.py is deleted.
verdicts.manifest: read; it records tests/test_imas_opener.py's negative control (1 failed, 6 passed under mutation) and the two-arm gate JSON with completed:false, exit 124 and 50 identical ids per arm.
verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's 16 declared write paths; the diff touches exactly 15 files, all inside that declared scope.
